text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Denomination and Characteristics of the Currency Notes
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denomination and characteristics of the currency notes to be issued on 9th September 1999 by the Board of Commissioners of Currency, Singapore, are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
description of the singapore “portrait” currency notes
The notes have one windowed machine-readable thread which is interwoven in the paper running vertically down the back of the notes. A watermark of the President’s portrait is incorporated on the left-hand side of the front of the note. The watermark is not overprinted on both the front and back. A highlight watermark which corresponds with the Braille pattern at the top right-hand corner of the front design, is located at the bottom of the Portrait watermark.
